## Overview

- Fix corruption of PowerPoint speaker-notes master XML during PPTX processing.
- Keep the shared Canvas Extension, Skill, npm CLI, and Desktop product version at 4.2.1.

## Compatibility and migration

This patch release is backward compatible with existing MarkdStage Markdown decks and the v4
installation model. Update version-pinned installation links to `v4.2.1`.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v4.2.1`. |
| PowerPoint export | Re-export affected decks to avoid the speaker-notes master XML corruption fixed in this release. |
